coordinated_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth and using the toilet
Preparing and eating breakfast, boiling water with the kettle and toasting bread
Getting dressed, checking phone and packing bag for the work shift
Commuting to the hospital for the day shift
Working as a health care professional, providing patient care and clinical documentation
Taking a lunch break and eating a packed meal
Continuing clinical duties, monitoring patients and coordinating with the care team
Cooking dinner with the induction cooker and oven, then eating
Clearing the table, washing dishes and loading the dishwasher
Taking a shower with the water heater and changing into comfortable clothes
Relaxing on the sofa and watching TV
Using the computer at the desk to check messages and unwind
Turning off the light and sleeping
